changes_vs_current: New topic. Gut check written before ranking (above). Raw average position over the 4 people sources: 1 Blackjack, 2 Poker, 3 Solitaire, 4 Go Fish, 5 Spades, 6 War, 7 Hearts, 8 Old Maid, 9 Cribbage, 10 Gin Rummy, 11 Canasta, 12 Crazy Eights, 13 Spoons, 14 Speed, 15 Euchre, 16 BS, 17 Bridge, 18 Pinochle, 19 Uno, 20 Pyramid, 21 Rummy, 22 Kings in the Corner, 23 Pitch, 24 Cards Against Humanity, then Hand and Foot, Thirty-one, Apples to Apples, Pitty Pat, Phase 10, Whist, Kemps, Skip-Bo.

Uno moved from raw #19 to #2: the 2023 YouGov poll (two of the four sources) never asked about Uno, so it was scored as missing there. Where it was asked it is #2 (Researchscape, 29% played last year) and #4 (YouGov familiarity 87%), and Circana ranks it the #1 traditional game in the US. Gut check #2.
Rummy moved from raw #21 to #7 for the same reason: YouGov 2023 asked only Gin Rummy. Rummy is #5 in YouGov familiarity (75%) and #7 in Researchscape (16%, above Hearts and War). Gut check #7.

Poker put #1 over Blackjack (raw 2.62 vs 3.75): Poker (with Texas Hold'em/stud merged in) is #1 in YouGov familiarity (90%) and wins 19 states in the Casinos.com Google Trends study (Blackjack wins 12). It is also the stock first answer. Blackjack #4 and Solitaire #3 sit in the raw top 4.

Crazy Eights moved from raw #12 to #11 and Gin Rummy kept at #12 (raw #10): both are gut-check items, and neither was offered in Researchscape, which scores them 29 there. Old Maid (raw #8) moved to #10 so that Rummy and Uno fit; War and Hearts are next to their raw spots.

Cribbage moved from raw #9 to #14: its 'ever played' is only 20% (#18 of 30 in YouGov) and 6% in Researchscape. Its raw rank came from being 1 of only 7 scored games in the small YouGov 2020 familiarity list.

Branded party games put at #13 (Cards Against Humanity), #18 (Phase 10), #19 (Apples to Apples) and #24 (Skip-Bo), all from raw #24-32. They were absent from YouGov 2023, which inflated their missing-penalty. In Researchscape, CAH (14%), Apples to Apples (11%) and Phase 10 (10%) all beat Bridge (7%), Cribbage (6%), Euchre/Canasta/Speed (5%) and Spoons (3%).

Pyramid folded into Solitaire as an alias (it is a solitaire variant). Pitch, Hand and Foot, Thirty-one, Pitty Pat, Whist and Kemps dropped: they are regional games with 7-14% ever played. Kings in the Corner (raw #22, 17% ever played, 4% last year) dropped for Skip-Bo, which the brief named and which has 5% last year and 70k Wikipedia views. Exploding Kittens left out: no US people source measured it (116k Wikipedia views only).

Alias choices: 'rummy' sits only on Rummy and 'gin' on Gin Rummy; 'spit' goes on Speed; 'cheat'/'i doubt it' go on BS; 'pyramid', 'klondike', 'spider solitaire' and 'freecell' go on Solitaire; 'texas holdem', 'seven card stud' and 'omaha' go on Poker.
confidence: medium. The top 6 (Poker, Uno, Solitaire, Blackjack, Go Fish, Spades) are consistent across two independent national polls and search data. But the main poll (YouGov 2023) omitted Uno, plain Rummy and every branded game, so their spots rest on the gut check plus Researchscape 2025 and YouGov 2020 familiarity. Crazy Eights and Gin Rummy rest on one poll only (two measures). The tail order (#14-24) among regional classics vs branded party games is soft.
